title: Rust authenticated peer SCHC context remains usable after Link trust retirement
description: rust/lichen-schc AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext compress/decompress/decompress_tracked methods authorize v3 processing from cached signer/version without a current LinkLayer evidence check. After unpin, forget, or rekey retires the retained authenticated frame generation, the cached context remains usable indefinitely; only FragmentationPolicy separately checks liveness. Bind general SCHC operations to current owner/key generation or remove capability-bearing public methods. Add unpin/rekey/forget and concurrent-retirement tests for all operations in std and no_std interfaces.
